title: Onboard helion-lite-6b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Khatri
description: Onboard helion-lite-6b v1.0 to the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and updated changelog automation. Motivation: helion-lite-6b is a lightweight variant requested by product for low-latency edge deployments; we need standardized metadata for model discovery, validated perf profiles (latency/throughput across typical seq lengths), and to ensure the automated changelog generator surfaces the new model in release notes. Changes include: updated model manifest and metadata (license, tokenizer, sample prompts), two perf profile entries (default and high-throughput), small inference config tweaks to prefer int8 quantization candidate, and an enhancement to the changelog automation script to pick up models with schema v2. Checklist: - [x] Model manifest added and validated against schema v2 - [x] Performance profiles generated (local lab and CI synthetic runs) - [x] Changelog automation updated to include model onboarding entries - [x] Docs updated with sample usage and model caveats - [x] CI green across tests (lint, unit, perf smoke) Rollout plan: merge to main and trigger registry sync job; previous onboarding pipelines will publish metadata to S3 and update the public model catalog. If any perf regressions appear in canary, rollback by pinning older profile for helion-lite-6b and open ENG-1108.

release_notes:
- Onboarded helion-lite-6b v1.0: lightweight 6B model optimized for low-latency deployments.
